jobs.title: Manager HVDC Service Warranty & Care
jobs.description: The opportunity HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group in Hitachi Energy, which develops, manufactures, and sells DC transmission systems on a global market. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances and for power transmission via submarine cables. It is also used to connect power systems. HVDC Service, based in Ludvika, Sweden, is now looking for a Manager to take on the role as the leader for the Service Warranty & Care to support and develop the individuals and the group and work for development of the department for a global growth. In this role, you will have personnel responsibility for a team of 15-20 professionals reporting directly to you. You will be tasked with ensuring that engineering teams are adequately resourced, developed, and equipped to meet business needs, as well as ensuring that the company's culture and values are reflected in all employee practices and policies. Your primary objective will be to motivate and engage your team and to support them to achieve their full potential, while ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations. Your Responsibilities HVDC Services core is to lead and manage employee relations, development and engage relations to foster a sense of community among employees. Building and developing the team and the individuals in it by managing employee training and development initiatives Providing strategic direction, leadership, and coordination of the function and operational work together with technical specialists. Providing insight and managing priorities for the team while ensuring activities’ performance and quality goals are met during all project phases. Taking a proactive approach and actively participate in recruiting activities. Planning for project staffing and adjusting it according to business needs, as well as planning for both short-term and more strategic long-term changes in the team structure. Partnering with the management team to develop, improve, and implement strategic people management initiatives and ensuring processes are in place to capture and share best practices and operational experiences. Your Background Experience as a people manager, or other relevant leadership or management experience with personnel responsibility, is highly qualifying. Experience in technology, engineering, electrical design, hardware design, or similar is required (if you have worked with HVDC technology before it is a plus). Strong communication, social, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with employees and management. Clear in decision making and have the right inner drive to take on full responsibility for your scope and deliver on time in a dynamic environment. Fluency in Swedish and English is a must. In this key leadership role, you will be responsible for managing a team of Field Service Engineers, Specialists, and Technicians supporting our Tissue customers mainly throughout EMEA region but also worldwide. You will have direct responsibility for field personnel based in Karlstad (Sweden) as well as other strategic Tissue Service locations across the EMEA region. You will ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality service delivery while driving operational excellence, employee development, customer satisfaction, and business growth. Working closely with Sales, Project Management, Performance Centers, Product Management, and regional Operations teams, you will play a critical role in strengthening Valmet’s position as the preferred service partner for Tissue producers. Primary Location: Karlstad (Sweden) or another major Valmet location in EMEA. Your responsibilities In your daily work, you will: Lead, coach, and develop a team of Field Service Engineers, Specialists, and Technicians located in Karlstad and other key EMEA service hubs. Manage resource planning, workforce allocation, and competence development to ensure efficient execution of field service activities. Ensure successful delivery of maintenance services, shutdowns, audits, inspections, troubleshooting assignments, machine upgrades, commissioning activities, and technical improvement projects. Support recruitment, onboarding, training, and career development of field service personnel. Define and monitor team performance through operational KPIs, utilization, customer satisfaction, profitability, safety, and employee engagement metrics. Ensure effective coordination between Field Services, Project Teams, Performance Centers, Engineering, and Product Organizations. Drive standardization and continuous improvement of service processes, methods, tools, and best practices. Act as an escalation point for critical customer issues and ensure timely resolution of customer concerns. Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and customer focus throughout the organization. Support the development and execution of strategic initiatives related to service growth, digitalization, remote services, and operational excellence. Expectations for you We expect you to bring: A degree in Engineering or equivalent technical experience. Several years of experience in industrial field services, maintenance, tissue production, project management, or related service operations. Proven experience in people leadership, team development, and performance management. Good knowledge of Tissue production technologies, maintenance practices, and customer operations. Experience managing multicultural teams and working within an international business environment. jobs.title: HVDC Service Customer Training Manager
jobs.description: Do you want to help customers succeed with some of the world's most advanced energy technologies while building long-term relationships that create real value? Customer Training is a key part of every HVDC Service project. It enables our customers to safely operate, maintain, and further develop their HVDC systems for decades to come. As Customer Training Manager, you will play a vital role in turning complex technical knowledge into practical learning experiences that support our customers throughout the lifecycle of their assets. In this role, you will own and coordinate the customer training deliverable from tender/Quotation phase through project execution and final handover. You will work closely with customers, project teams, technical experts, trainers, suppliers, and service organizations around the world to ensure successful training delivery. You will be part of the HVDC Service Project Support organization, a diverse and collaborative team where planning, documentation, field operations, and training experts work together to support customers globally. We believe in teamwork, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and empowering each other to succeed. What makes this role unique is the opportunity to follow customer training throughout the entire customer journey. Within HVDC Service, you will contribute to projects that extend the life, performance, and reliability of critical energy infrastructure, helping customers maximize the value of their HVDC investments long after the initial project delivery. We are interested in learning more about you and what you can contribute with, so please apply even if you don't meet every requirement. How you'll make an impact Lead and coordinate customer training activities throughout the HVDC Service project lifecycle. Translate customer requirements and technical specifications into training strategies, concepts, schedules, budgets, and deliverables.
